annotations.title: Check your account, credits and free runs left

description: Shows who Neumann thinks you are and what you can still do: your credit balance if you have an account, or your free runs left today and when they reset if you do not. Use this when you need to know, before or after a run, whether a call will use credits or a free run, how much is left, or whether you are signed in. A bearer credential that is not recognized returns an unauthorized error. It returns whether you are anonymous or an account, your account id and status, credit balance, free runs left today with the reset time and the no-account size limits, the price of one credit in US dollars, and your last 10 credit transactions. To get an account and API key, call POST https://neumann.kromatic.com/api/v1/accounts; setup docs are at https://kromatic.com/mcp/neumann. Cost: free; uses no credits and no free runs.
name: check_account_and_credits
